english.legislation: Contrary to section 46(2) of the Police Reform Act 2002.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) While the offence in section 46 has remained the same, the types of designation of police staff and volunteers have changed as of 1st December 2017. For offences committed before that date refer to CJS code PL02004.
(ii) 'Designated person' includes those designated under section 38(1) or (1A) and also those civilian employees designated under this provision in one force and in relation to whom a designation is in force under section 38B under a collaboration agreement with another force, see section 46(5).

other.powersofarrest:
Arrest without warrant (constable)
Persons designated under section 38 of the Police Reform Act 2002 have no power to arrest, see section 38(6B) and paragraph 1 of Schedule 3B (excluded powers); however, there is a power to detain the person for a maximum of 30 minutes pending the arrival of a constable, see paragraph 7 of Schedule 3C to the Police Reform Act 2002.
other.penalty:
One month imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level three on the legislative standard scale
